issue: CSPH card is built on Baveno VII and says "a later Baveno edition was not verified here", but Baveno VIII (J Hepatol 2026;85(5):993-1018, PMID 42624290) is published and sits in the project HCC reference depot. Baveno VIII revised the non-invasive criteria. Rule-in is now ANTICIPATE/ANTICIPATE-NASH (or NICER) probability >=75%, LSM >=25 kPa (virus/alcohol/non-obese MASLD), or SSM (100 Hz) >55 kPa. The Baveno VII grey-zone statement shown on the card (">=60% risk at 20-25 kPa with PLT <150, or 15-20 kPa with PLT <110") is not carried forward. Indeterminate results are re-evaluated at 12 months. New HCC-specific statements: NITs may not apply with macrovascular invasion; the rule-out holds in BCLC 0-C; ANTICIPATE >=75% is highly suggestive only in BCLC 0-A without a >5 cm right-lobe nodule. The card is shown at the HCC curative-route (resection vs transplant/ablation) decision.

issue: The sum is a floating-point reduce, compared with "sum <= 8". Sets of 0.1 cm sizes that total exactly 8.0 cm can sum to 8.000000000000002, depending on entry order, and are then reported "outside" the downstaging criteria. issue: The form, read-out and card define the size term as the "largest viable tumor diameter". In Metroticket 2.0 a nodule is counted if it is active (arterial enhancement with washout, "even in the context of a necrotic nodule"), and "the maximum diameter was measured, including any concomitant necrotic areas". Only nodules of 1 cm or more count. Entering the enhancing-rim diameter (mRECIST-style) understates the sum and can flip out to in.

issue: The disease-free-interval factor is worded "primary resection to liver metastasis diagnosis under 12 months". Fong 1999 scores a disease-free interval under 12 months, and that includes synchronous presentation; Dueland 2020 scores it as "synchronous metastatic disease (<12 months from diagnosis)". Read literally, the label gives 0 for synchronous metastases found before or at primary resection, so a common subgroup is under-scored by one point and can move from the 3–5 to the 0–2 group.
